summary.text: Peter Wood is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 81 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a small business owner and a member of the MSAD 17 school board.

paragraphs.text: Peter Wood graduated from Oxford Hills High School, and his career experience includes working as a small business owner.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Norway/Paris Fish and Game Club and the Waterford Fish and Game Club.
He assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 3, 2024, succeeding Sawin Millett Jr.
He is also a member of the Maine School Administrative District 17 school board, representing Norway, with a term ending in 2027.
